name: PostEverywhere
description:
PostEverywhere connects Claude to every major social network so you can plan, create, and publish content across all your accounts in one conversation.

Publish everywhere at once. Write a post once and send it to X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram, and Discord. Customize the caption and format per platform (Reels, Stories, Shorts) when you want, or let sensible defaults handle it.

Schedule and stay in control. Schedule posts for any time in any timezone, save drafts for human review before anything goes live, and manage everything in bulk (up to 50 posts in one request). Nothing publishes without your say-so unless you ask it to.

Bring your media. Attach images from a URL or your PostEverywhere media library, organize work into campaigns, and generate on-brand captions with AI.

See what's working. Pull cross-platform analytics summaries, check per-post results on every network, monitor account health, and retry failed posts with one command.

  Every tool is annotated as read-only or destructive, so Claude asks before anything irreversible. Requires a PostEverywhere account (7-day free trial at posteverywhere.ai); connect your social accounts once and Claude handles the rest.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PostEverywhere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PostEverywhere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.posteverywhere.ai/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PostEverywhere MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PostEverywhere lists 35 MCP tools, including bulk_create_posts, connect_credential_account, create_campaign, create_connect_link, create_post, create_reconnect_link, create_webhook, delete_campaign, delete_media, delete_post, delete_webhook, and generate_caption.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PostEverywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PostEverywhere in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PostEverywhere requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PostEverywhere is developed by PostEverywhere Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
